answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 41872 Country: India Title: I heard from someone that working on Eid al-Fitr is haram, and I have work for 5 hours on Eid Question: I heard from someone that working on Eid al-Fitr is haram, and I have work for 5 hours on Eid. Are the wages of that 5 hours haram for me? Answer ID: 41872 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1516/1516/M=1433) It is lawful and halal to earn on the day of Eid like other days provided the income source is not haram. No book says that working on Eid day is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
